__doc: Floors per model for the share of PRs the stage answered right on cases.json (run.js --gate), as ratios.

eval-fake (the wiring smoke, every PR): deterministic. Two runs of the same commit gave 1 of 3 alike: the scripted analyzer's answer is published as a gap on both PRs it reaches (right on missing-requirement's outcome, without the word it must name; wrong on fully-implemented), and the unreadable ticket is skipped. floor = observed.

deepseek-v4-flash@fireworks (the nightly model): calibrated 2026-10-16 from 2 local runs on one commit, 2 of 3 each, every case alike (paired difference 0); a third run with --verify gave the same. fully-implemented fails in all three: the analyzer answers '**Status:** Compliant' (the format SKILL.md prescribes) and the stage's classifyResult does not read that as a pass, so it publishes 'Business logic gap detected'. floor = observed: any further miss fails, and the nightly measures again before alerting. With the stage's classification broken to call every answer a pass: 1 of 3, below the floor.
RATCHET: a PR that moves the value on purpose (the stage's classification, the skill, the cases) recalibrates here in the same PR, with its runs as evidence.
